description: src/ocaml/lib/ai_linter/gleam_rules.ml is the largest source file in the repo (1414 lines, 41 detectors). Audit found DRY/SRP violations and several reliability bugs. Plan: fix behavioral bugs first (small, localized), add golden tests to lock behavior, then consolidate traversal boilerplate onto the shared fold, then split into thematic modules mirroring the crystal_rules_* layout. Full detail lives in child tickets.
title: gleam_rules.ml: refactor for readability & reliability
